40019263.author: पदार्थः
40019263.content: सरोषेण in anger, राघवेण by Raghava, एवम् in that way, परुषम् harsh, रोमहर्षणम् horripilating, उक्ता spoken, वैदेहि Vaidehi, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रव्यथिता afflicted, अभवत् became

40019263.author: Translation
40019263.content: Vaidehi heard the harsh horripilating words spoken by Rama in anger and was very much afflicted.

40019264.author: पदार्थः
40019264.content: तदा then, सामैथिली she, Mythili, महति large number, जने people, अश्रुतपूर्वम् filled with tears, घोरम् ruthless, भर्तुः husband 's, वचःwords, श्रुत्वा hearing, लज्जया shy, अवनता bent, अभवत् stayed

40019264.author: Translation
40019264.content: Then Mythili hearing her husband 's harsh words, in the presence of a large number of people, stayed bent with shyness.

40019265.author: पदार्थः
40019265.content: साजनकात्मजा she Janaka's daughter, स्वानि her own, गात्राणि limbs, प्रविशन्तीव shrinking, तैःthose, चाक्षरैः from eyes, सशल्येव by the arrows, भृशम् excessively, अश्रूणि tears, अवर्तयत् shed

40019265.author: Translation
40019265.content: As if pierced by those arrowlike words, Janaka's daughter shed tears excessively, shrinking into her own limbs.

40019266.author: पदार्थः
40019266.content: ततः thereafter, बाष्पपरिक्लिन्नम् flowing tears clean, स्वम् her, आननम् face, प्रमार्जन्ती wiping off, भर्तारम् to husband, गद्गदया in broken tone, वाचा words, शनैः slowly, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke

40019266.author: Translation
40019266.content: Thereafter, wiping her face clean from flowing tears she spoke slowly in a choked voice in broken words to her husband.

40019267.author: पदार्थः
40019267.content: वीर hero, माम् me, प्राकृतः address, प्राकृतामिव like a common man, माम् to me, असदृशम् unkind, ईदृशब् this kind of tone, श्रोत्रदारुणम् harsh to hear, रूक्षम् rude, वाक्यम् words, किम् why, श्रावयसे speaking

40019267.author: Translation
40019267.content: "Hero! Why are you addressing me in such harsh unkind words in a rude manner, in a harsh tone like a common man?"

40019268.author: पदार्थः
40019268.content: महाबाहो mighty armed, माम् me, यथा similarly, अवगच्छसि not as you think of me, तथा so also, न अस्मिI am not, मे my, प्रत्ययम् proof, गच्छ period, स्वेन myself, चारित्रेण my past, ते to you, शपे vow

40019268.author: Translation
40019268.content: "O Mighty armed! I am not as you think of me, so also show me a proof of it in my past. I swear on my past."

40019269.author: पदार्थः
40019269.content: पृथकस्त्रीणां vulgar women, प्रचारेण extending, त्वम् you, जातिम् race, परिशङ्कसे doubting, अहम् I, ते to you, परीक्षितायदि if you have examined, एनाम् these, शङ्काम् doubts, परित्यज give up

40019269.author: Translation
40019269.content: "You give up judging all womankind by the path followed by vulgar women. You give up these doubts if you have examined."

40019270.author: पदार्थः
40019270.content: प्रभो Lord, विवशा helpless, अहम् I am, गात्रसम्पर्शम् touching the limbs, गता in the past, अस्मि by me, इतियत् all this, तत्र there, मे to me, कामकारः acting at will, न not, तत्र there, दैवम् fate, अपराध्यति to be blamed

40019270.author: Translation
40019270.content: "O Lord! I was helpless when Ravana contacted my limbs in the past. I was not acting according to my will. My fate is to be blamed and not me."

40019271.author: पदार्थः
40019271.content: यत् that which, मदधीनम् mind under my control, तत् that, मे is my, हृदयंतु heart, त्वयि you, वर्तते abides, पराधीनेषु at others' mercy, गात्रेषु limbs, अनीश्वरी not possible, किम् what, करिष्यामि can I do

40019271.author: Translation
40019271.content: "That mind which is under my control is my heart and it abides in you. What can I do about my limbs when I am at others' mercy?"

40019272.author: पदार्थः
40019272.content: मानद honourable, सहसम्वृद्धभावेन by our growing up together with love, संसर्गेणच our intimate relationship, अहम् I, ते to you, न विज्ञातायदि if I am not known, तेन by you, शाश्वतम् permanently, हताअस्मि I am done

40019272.author: Translation
40019272.content: "Honourable Rama! If I am not understood by you despite our growing up together with love and in spite of our intimate relationship, I am done forever."

40019273.author: पदार्थः
40019273.content: राजन् king, महावीरः great hero, हनुमान् Hanuman, अवलोककः to find, ते by you, प्रेषितः sent, लङ्कास्था in Lanka, अहम् I, त्वया by you, तदा then, किम् why, न विसर्जिता did you not leave

40019273.author: Translation
40019273.content: "King! When the great hero Hanuman was sent by you to find me in Lanka, why did you not leave me then."

40019274.author: पदार्थः
40019274.content: वीर heroic, अस्य your, वानरस्य with Vanara, प्रत्यक्षम् in his presence, तद्वाक्यसमनन्तरम् after your message, त्वया by you, सन्त्यक्तया, मया by me, जीवितम् life, त्यक्तम् given up, स्यात् there itself

40019274.author: Translation
40019274.content: "O hero! Had you given me up immediately on receiving your message from Vanara I would have given up my life in the presence of Hanuman there itself."

40019275.author: पदार्थः
40019275.content: जीवितम् life, संशये doubt, न्यस्य exertion, ते to you, वृधा wasteful, अयंश्रमः this hard work, न स्यात् perhaps not required, अयम् this, विफलः failure, तव your, सुहृज्जनपरिक्लेशः nor your friends, न च and not

40019275.author: Translation
40019275.content: "O Life! If you had a doubt this exertion to you is wasteful. This fruitless hard work was perhaps not required on your part nor your friends."

40019276.author: पदार्थः
40019276.content: नृपशार्दूल tiger among kings, रोषमेव gave yourself to anger, अनुवर्तता following, त्वयातु you also, लघुना weak, मनुष्येणइव like a man, स्त्रीत्वमेव womanliness, प पुरस्कृतम् adopting

40019276.author: Translation
40019276.content: "O tiger among kings! You also gave up yourself to anger like a weak man and adopted womanliness"

40019277.author: पदार्थः
40019277.content: वृत्तज्ञ divine birth, अपदेशेव mentioned, जनकात् birth, वसुधातलात् in the ground, उत्पततिः risen, मम me, बहु many, वृत्तं च divine origin, ते you, पुरस्कृतम् considered

40019277.author: Translation
40019277.content: She who arose from the surface of the earth by way of Janaka, and my own conduct—O knower of conduct, much of this you have not held in honour.

40019278.author: पदार्थः
40019278.content: बाल्ये young, निपीडितः pressed, ममपाणिः my hand, न प्रमाणीकृतः as a mark of acceptance, मम my, भक्तिश्च with devotion, शीलं च my character, सर्वम् all, ते to you, पृष्ठतः chastity, कृतम् not taken into account

40019278.author: Translation
40019278.content: "When in my young age you held my hand as a mark of acceptance (in our marriage), has it not been considered by you? Has my devotion, character and chastity not been taken into account?"

40019279.author: पदार्थः
40019279.content: इति thus, बृवन्ती speaking, रूदती weeping, बाष्पगद्गदभाषिणी with tears and choked throat, सीता Sita, दीनम् piteous, ध्यानपरायणम् absorbed in mind, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, उवाच spoke

40019279.author: Translation
40019279.content: Thus speaking, and weeping with tears, with choked throat, Sita was absorbed in her mind and piteous. She spoke to Lakshmana.

40019280.author: पदार्थः
40019280.content: सौमित्रे Saumithri, मे I, अस्य this, व्यसनस्य sorrow, भेषजम् cure, चिताम् pyre, कुरु arrange, मिथ्यापवादोपहता false reproaches, अहम् I, जीवितुम् to live, न उत्सहे not desire

40019280.author: Translation
40019280.content: "Saumithri! Cure for this sorrow is only pyre. Arrange for pyre as I do not desire to live with false reproaches."

40019281.author: पदार्थः
40019281.content: गुणैः virtues, अप्रीतेन not pleased, भर्त्रा husband, जनसंसदि gathering of people, त्यक्तायाः left out, मे I, या that, गतिः path, गन्तुम् will go, क्षमा tolerance, हव्यवाहनम् offer myself to oblations, प्रवेक्ष्यामि will enter fire

40019281.author: Translation
40019281.content: "When my husband is not pleased with my virtues, renounces me in the gathering of people, I have only that path for me, that is, entering fire and offering myself as oblation."

40019282.author: पदार्थः
40019282.content: वैदेह्या by Vaidehi, एवम् in that manner, उक्तः spoken, परवीरहा destroyer of enemies, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अमर्षवशम् with indignation, आपन्नः overcome, राघवम् Raghava, समुदैक्षत looked at

40019282.author: Translation
40019282.content: Spoken in that manner by Vaidehi, Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemies, overcome with indignation looked at Raghava.

40019283.author: पदार्थः
40019283.content: वीर्यवान् valiant, सःसौमित्रिः Saumithri, रामस्य Rama's, आकारसूचितम् indication from his looks, ततश्छन्दम् accordingly, विज्ञाय understanding, रामस्य Rama's, मते earth, चिताम् pyre, चकार started

40019283.author: Translation
40019283.content: Understanding Rama's indication from his looks, Saumithri started to prepare the earth for pyre.

40019284.author: पदार्थः
40019284.content: तदा there upon, कालान्तकयमोपमम् like Yama the god of death, रामम् Rama, कश्चित् indeed, सुहृत् no one dear to him, अनुनेतुम् make a request, अथो so also, वक्तुम् speak, द्रष्टुंवापि or see, न अशकत् हि not pacify

40019284.author: Translation
40019284.content: Indeed, no friend or dear could see or speak or make a request or pacify Rama. at that time.

40019285.author: पदार्थः
40019285.content: ततः thereafter, वैदेही Vaidehi, अधोमुखम् walking clockwise, स्थितम् stood, रामम् at Rama, प्रदक्षिणंकृत्वा went round in accordance with tradition, दीप्यमानम् glowing, हुताशनम् pyre, उपावर्तत approached

40019285.author: Translation
40019285.content: Thereafter, Vaidehi, walking clockwise near Rama went round him in accordance with tradition and approached the pyre.

40019286.author: पदार्थः
40019286.content: मैथिली Mythili, दैवतेभ्यश्च even to gods, ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च brahmanas, प्रणम्य greeting with joined palms, अनगिसमीपतः near fire, बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा again joining her palms, इदम् this, उवाच च spoke

40019286.author: Translation
40019286.content: Mythili greeted the gods and brahmanas with joined palms and went near fire and again joined her palms in greeting and spoke as follows.

40019287.author: पदार्थः
40019287.content: मे my, हृदयम् mind, राघवात् at Raghava, नापसर्पतियथा never slid at all, तथा so also, लोकस्य world's, साक्षी witness, पावकः fire god, माम् me, सर्वतःalways, पातु protect me

40019287.author: Translation
40019287.content: "If it is true that my heart has never slid from Raghava at all, may the fire god protect me always and so also the world witness."

40019288.author: पदार्थः
40019288.content: शुद्धचरिताम् unimpeachable conduct, माम् me, राघवः Raghava, दुष्टाम् seeing, जानाति not know, यथा similarly, तथा that way, लोकस्य world, साक्षी witness, पावकः fire, सर्वतः all sides, माम् me, पातु protect me

40019288.author: Translation
40019288.content: "If in Rama's view, I am of impeccable conduct and so also if what he is seeing is not known to be true, let the world witness and fire god protect me."

40019289.author: पदार्थः
40019289.content: अहम् I, कर्मणा by action, मनसा at heart, वाचा in speech, सर्वधर्मज्ञम् knower of all virtues, राघवम् Raghava, यथानातिचरामि that way not walked the path of virtue, यथा so also, माम् me, पावकः fire god, पातु protect me

40019289.author: Translation
40019289.content: 'If I have ever acted or been unfaithful at heart or in speech and did not follow a righteous path with Rama, who is a knower of all virtues, let the fire god protect me."

40019290.author: पदार्थः
40019290.content: भगवान् O god, आदित्यः Aditya, वायुः wind god, दिशः god of the four quarters, तथैव च by you, चन्द्रः moon, अहश्चापि me, सन्ध्ये twilight, रात्रिश्च night, तथा so also, पृथिवी earth, अन्येऽपि and other gods, चारित्रसम्युताम् woman of character, विजानन्ति accept यथा similarly, तथा let it happen that way

40019290.author: Translation
40019290.content: "O gods! Supreme Aditya, wind god, god of the four quarters, and also by moon, and gods presiding during day, night, twilight and so also earth, know me as a woman of good character, let the fire god protect me that way."

40019291.author: पदार्थः
40019291.content: वैदेही Vaidehi, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा spoken, हुताशनम् pyre, परिक्रम्य went round, निःशङ्केन fearless, अन्तरात्मना absorbed in self, दीप्तम् flaming, ज्वलनम् burning, विवेशळ entered

40019291.author: Translation
40019291.content: Having spoken in that way, Vaidehi went round fire fearlessly, absorbed with in herself and entered the flaming and burning fire.

40019292.author: पदार्थः
40019292.content: तत्र there, बालवृद्धसमाकुलः young and old assembled, सुमहान् gathering, जनश्च people, हुताशनम् fire, प्रविशन्तीम् entering, दीप्ताम् flaming, मैथिलीम् Mythili, ददर्श witnessed

40019292.author: Translation
40019292.content: Young and old assembled there, and the gathering of people witnessed Mythili entering the flaming and burning fire.

40019293.author: पदार्थः
40019293.content: तप्तनवहेमाभा like polished gold, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणा like shining ornament of gold, सा she, सर्वलोकस्य total world, सन्निधौ presence, दीप्तम् flaming, ज्वलनम् glowing, पपात fell

40019293.author: Translation
40019293.content: Like freshly polished gold, like shining gold ornament, in the presence of the whole world she fell into flaming and glowing fire.

40019294.author: पदार्थः
40019294.content: विशालाक्षीम् large eyed goddess of fortune, हन्यवाहनम् on her vehicle, पतन्तीम् descending, रुक्मवेदिनिभाम् golden altar, तांसीताम् her, Sita, सर्वाणि all beings, रूपाणि forms, ददृशुः witnessed

40019294.author: Translation
40019294.content: All created beings and forms witnessed large eyed Sita descending on the golden altar, into the fire like goddess of fortune descending on her vehicle.

40019295.author: पदार्थः
40019295.content: हुताशनम् fire, प्रविशन्तीम् entering, महाभागाम् noble, तांसीताम् Sita, कृत्स्नाः dark, त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, पुण्याम् blessed, आज्याहुतीमिव like ghee offered to fire, ददृशुः witnessed

40019295.author: Translation
40019295.content: All the three worlds witnessed noble dark Sita entering the fire, like ghee offered to fire.

40019296.author: पदार्थः
40019296.content: अध्वरे priests, मन्स्सरैः recitation of sacred verses, संस्कृताम् traditionally, वसोः dwelling there, धारामिव like the flow, हव्यवाहवे in sacrificial fire, पतन्तीम् falling, ताम् her, दृष्टवा seeing, सर्वाः all, स्त्रियःwomen, प्रचुक्रुशुःfled screaming

40019296.author: Translation
40019296.content: All the women who stood there fled, screaming on seeing Sita falling into fire, like the flow of ghee poured continuously into sacrificial fire reciting sacred verses by priests.

40019297.author: पदार्थः
40019297.content: त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, देवगन्धर्वदानवाः Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas, शस्ताम् extolled her, निरये hell, त्रिदिवात् three worlds, पतन्तीम् fallen, देवतामिव like goddess, ताम् they, ददृशुः saw

40019297.author: Translation
40019297.content: All the Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas of the three worlds who witnessed her falling, extolled her as if goddess was falling from heaven into hell.
